WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.label: rite of living wood
WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.description: Awaken ordinary wood with herbs into living wood at a first-tier or higher altar. This fixed transmutation gains no resonance bonus.

WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.label: rite of elven steel
WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.description: Temper steel with living wood into elven steel at a second-tier or higher altar. This fixed transmutation gains no resonance bonus.

WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.label: rite of adamantine
WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.description: Refine elven steel and plasteel into adamantine at a third-tier altar. This fixed transmutation gains no resonance bonus.

WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.label: rite of mithril
WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.description: Refine elven steel and silver into mithril at a third-tier altar. This fixed transmutation gains no resonance bonus.
